app.name: Property Ledger
app.description: Expenses, rent and each owner's share for jointly owned buildings.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.emptyBody: Each month's earnings, expenses and owner shares will appear here once you start recording them.

expenses.title: Expenses
expenses.emptyBody: Electricity, caretaker, service charge, taxes and repairs will be listed here by month.

rent.title: Rent
rent.emptyBody: Flats, tenants, payments and dues will be tracked here.

reports.title: Reports
reports.emptyBody: Monthly statements for each owner will be available here as PDF and Excel files.

more.title: More
more.emptyBody: Owners, buildings, shares, meters, categories and backups will be managed here.

update.ready: A new version of the app is ready.

profile.title: About you
profile.body: You are the owner who records everything. Co-owners do not use the app.

buildings.title: Your buildings
buildings.body: Add each building you own with others. You can add details later.

owners.title: Co-owners
owners.body: Add the people who share ownership with you.

shares.title: Ownership shares
shares.body: Enter each owner's percentage of every building. Expenses and rent are split by these shares.
shares.needOwnersAndBuildings: Add buildings first. You can set shares later from More.

done.title: You're all set
done.body: Expense categories are ready. You can change anything later from More.
done.installBody: In Chrome, open the ⋮ menu and choose "Install app" or "Add to home screen". The app then opens like any other app and works without internet.

buildings.title: Buildings
buildings.emptyBody: Add the buildings you own with others.
